notes: Page header lists several Essick Air/Champion Cooler brands together, but the body presents this system for Champion Cooler brand equipment on the UltraCool page; filed under the briefed ultracool slug with that framing noted. Counting judgment (flagged): year read as the 2nd and 3rd characters (both digits, giving 07 -> 2007 on the page example E07141664), not digit-sequence counting (which would give 71 -> 1971). Character counting is supported by the page itself: it italicizes the date group as the first three characters E07, and elsewhere on Building Center pages 'digit' is used loosely for 'character' (e.g. a leading letter is called the 'first digit'). The digit-count reading would make the date code non-contiguous (chars 1, 3, 4), inconsistent with the italicized group. Month letter held: it decodes only via a chart image that cannot be read here.

styles.notes: Year is the 2nd and 3rd characters per page text under the character-counting reading (see brand notes). Month is the 1st character letter via a chart image (Champion_Essick-Air_Spec-Air-Serial-Number-Style-1_How-to-determine-the-date-of-manufacture-or-age.png) that cannot be read here, so month is held, not guessed; file is year-only.
